mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PP.PRODUCT_ID, PR.PROMOTION_ID, PR.PROMOTION_TITLE, PR.DISCOUNT_TYPE, PR.DISCOUNT_VALUE, PR.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT, PR.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PP.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY PR.PROMOTION_ID DESC) as RN FROM PROMOTION_PRODUCT PP JOIN PROMOTION PR ON PP.PROMOTION_ID = PR.PROMOTION_ID -- WHERE 절 삭제함 (무조건 표시) ) WHERE RN = 1 ) PROMO ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PROMO.PRODUCT_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK_QUANTITY, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.IMAGE_URL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT,
PROMO.PROMOTION_ID AS PR_ID, PROMO.PROMOTION_TITLE AS PR_TITLE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_TYPE AS PR_TYPE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_VALUE AS PR_VALUE, PROMO.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT AS PR_MIN_AMOUNT, PROMO.STATUS AS PR_STATUS,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST W WHERE W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND W.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS IS_WISHED
FROM PRODUCT P
AND P.STATUS IN ('SALE', 'SOLD_OUT')
AND P.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.*, PROMO.PROMOTION_ID AS PR_ID, PROMO.PROMOTION_TITLE AS PR_TITLE /* 필요한 컬럼들... */ FROM PRODUCT P
/* WHERE 절에서 STATUS 조건을 없애거나, 모든 상태를 포함시킵니다 */ WHERE P.STATUS IN ('SALE', 'SOLD_OUT', 'STOP') ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK_QUANTITY, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.IMAGE_URL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT,
PROMO.PROMOTION_ID AS PR_ID, PROMO.PROMOTION_TITLE AS PR_TITLE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_TYPE AS PR_TYPE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_VALUE AS PR_VALUE, PROMO.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT AS PR_MIN_AMOUNT, PROMO.STATUS AS PR_STATUS,
0 AS IS_WISHED FROM PRODUCT P
WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND_NAME, P.PRICE, P.IMAGE_URL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, PROMO.PROMOTION_ID AS PR_ID, PROMO.PROMOTION_TITLE AS PR_TITLE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_TYPE AS PR_TYPE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_VALUE AS PR_VALUE, PROMO.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT AS PR_MIN_AMOUNT, PROMO.STATUS AS PR_STATUS, 0 AS IS_WISHED FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'SALE' ORDER BY P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND_NAME, P.PRICE, P.IMAGE_URL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, PROMO.PROMOTION_ID AS PR_ID, PROMO.PROMOTION_TITLE AS PR_TITLE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_TYPE AS PR_TYPE, PROMO.DISCOUNT_VALUE AS PR_VALUE, PROMO.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT AS PR_MIN_AMOUNT, PROMO.STATUS AS PR_STATUS, 0 AS IS_WISHED FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'SALE' ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
